Players Committee card image of [[What Chance Do We Have? (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. Whenever you lost Force (except from a Force drain or your card) during opponent's control phase, unless opponent occupies more battlegrounds that you, may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/whatchancedowehave.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
